svg.title: TensorRT-Alpha inference pipeline
svg.desc: Sources (image, camera, url) feed an input queue of batches held in pinned memory. preprocess, inference and postprocess run on the GPU; each worker owns one thread, one execution context and one cudaStream that carries the whole pre-infer-post chain. preprocess and postprocess are hand-written, vectorized (vec) and fused into a single CUDA C kernel launch each, so no intermediate tensor ever round-trips through the CPU. Results land in a second pinned-memory queue, then are rendered per task: det, seg, pose, obb, cls, depth.

g.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
